$comment: Vision components. Hosted at components.taalcut.app by tools/components/hosting (README.md, "Releasing components"; hosting/plan.mjs pins each source). sign-manifest.mjs drops this comment. Each archive is one tar.zst made with the audio lane's recipe: sorted names, ustar, uid 0, gid 0, mode 0644, mtime 0 (files utime'd to 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z; bsdtar 3.5.3 ignores SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH), packed with COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0 tar --format ustar --uid 0 --gid 0 --numeric-owner --no-xattrs --no-mac-metadata --no-acls --no-fflags and zstd 1.5.7 -19 -T1. hosting/build.mjs packs embeddinggemma-2 and ppocr-v5-devanagari again from their pinned upstream files with this recipe (hosting/archive.mjs, layout "stream") and gets the same sha256; the Core ML archives come from their pack scripts. embeddinggemma-2: onnx-community/embeddinggemma-2-ONNX revision daa72c51243991dfcaf9f9137d2c573d8f7790c0, q4 text graph and q4f16 vision graph only (no audio encoder; vision loads it with audio_config null). The vision graph is q4f16 since IX-E2 (2026-10-17): the same int4 weights as vision_encoder_q4 with fp16 activations, 1.6-2.2x the frames per second on WebGPU with vectors at cosine >= 0.99997 to q4 (vision SPEC, 'Indexing speed: the embedder'); vision still loads a folder that has only vision_encoder_q4. Packed with the recipe above; a second pack gave the same sha256. Archive layout: chat_template.jinja, config.json, config_sentence_transformers.json, onnx/model_q4.onnx, onnx/model_q4.onnx_data, onnx/vision_encoder_q4f16.onnx, onnx/vision_encoder_q4f16.onnx_data, preprocessor_config.json, processor_config.json, tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json. Source sha256: model_q4.onnx 490742 f9eeba97acddf139b8ee2ddf04bc30dceafa88de93fadf74d7644e0d61a477a9; model_q4.onnx_data 174028800 c3975f2d1ab7a1878ae31a7d7a9b7804a827aff3800b60dfceafce21cac3df49; vision_encoder_q4f16.onnx 150693 55975fba53928162eee37e9eea2a69965c10c0411ed14c24ea149efa55a8aa68; vision_encoder_q4f16.onnx_data 97614336 842f996aff092e300c966266ae0cc60771c6ca16282fee04ca83f0f159bc6b33. ppocr-v5-devanagari: PaddlePaddle/devanagari_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec_onnx revision 251aec19e36739540d35e2cc943f6aa7503b98e5 and PaddlePaddle/PP-OCRv5_mobile_det_onnx revision e6f4fa85f00e168c862bc462aebca69eef9b3d3d. Archive layout: charset.json, det/inference.onnx, det/inference.yml, rec/inference.onnx, rec/inference.yml. charset.json (3649 bytes, 621d0073b27b8d8ff19629ee7a961f337697f553a29f21c9817057f4359549c3) is the recogniser's character list from rec/inference.yml as a JSON array, written by vision; it has no url. Source sha256: det/inference.onnx 4826518 a431985659dc921974177a95adcfbb90fd9e51989a5e04d70d0b75f597b6e61d; det/inference.yml 903 98069072e1b6b37d727fd9d9f11725faa46d6ea0de012f2ed26caea011c37699; rec/inference.onnx 7912311 cb789212ce96c69d3e74728ae4309d179281d68cb3945d0616b67cafab41c986; rec/inference.yml 5027 9bd172dd26440c8ce94d1cde5d5baea6aefdc7cf3c5c8492e0beedef656d4e54. onnxruntime: the darwin arm64 binding from the onnxruntime-node 1.30.0 npm tarball, both Mach-O files signed with the Developer ID (Matterward Labs, team WW382UC8JD; hardened runtime, secure timestamp) and packed by tools/components/pack-onnxruntime.sh (bin/napi-v6/darwin/arm64/libonnxruntime.1.30.0.dylib, onnxruntime_binding.node, and the relative symlink libonnxruntime.1.dylib -> libonnxruntime.1.30.0.dylib). Shared with audio's Beat This!, which also runs on onnxruntime-node 1.30.0. The app loads onnxruntime-node's binding from this component folder, not from node_modules (apps/desktop src/utility/component-natives.ts). embeddinggemma-2-coreml (IX2-E5, 2026-10-18): FluidInference/embeddinggemma-2-coreml revision 3f978ddf92cac9aa07eb2dcf6eb36cf450f3dba4 (the two .mlpackage graphs and position_embeddings.f16, sha256 in tools/components/embeddinggemma-coreml/checksums.txt) with every weight matrix replaced by the embeddinggemma-2 component's dequantized q4/q4f16 weight (q4_surgery.py: 218 text and 114 vision matrices, correlation to Fluid's fp16 about 0.996), the q4 token table as embeddings.f16 and the q4 position tables as position_embeddings.f16, compiled with xcrun coremlcompiler 3520.5.1 and packed with the recipe above by tools/components/pack-embeddinggemma-coreml.sh. From IX3-N3 (2026-10-20, version 2.1.0-coreml-q4recipe-daa72c5-fluid3f978dd) the archive carries no weights: weight_recipe.py replaces both weight.bin files and the token table (now embeddings.q4, the ONNX component's own 4-bit table, token_table.py) with weights.json and weights.raw (3.4 MB: blob headers, norms and rotary tables), a recipe that rebuilds them byte for byte from embeddinggemma-2's onnx/model_q4.onnx_data and onnx/vision_encoder_q4f16.onnx_data (checked when packed, and by sha256 when the app writes them into expanded/ on first use); the model is the 2.0.0 one unchanged. Archive layout: EmbeddingGemma2Text.mlmodelc/ and EmbeddingGemma2Vision.mlmodelc/ (without weights/), position_embeddings.f16, weights.json, weights.raw. transnetv2 (IX2-C2): the ONNX export of TransNetV2 by elya5 (hf.co/elya5/transnetv2, revision e1cfcb717af91e41ffb84b5fd851505682c576ee, MIT; base model Sn4kehead/TransNetV2, a PyTorch port of the upstream weights), byte-identical at hf.co/edgetools/transnetv2 revision 4b2cef0e4f246904228785e9f0a693a2363e0a6b, installed as the one file transnetv2.onnx. Hosted unchanged (sha256 c4d54a682bace32f25136ef83ca2c9d403e8f8193775efeb995172a0d95a8e0c, 31250929 bytes). Its outputs match upstream's TF SavedModel (github.com/soCzech/TransNetV2 commit 85cef72af9a916bdfd7cc94a670c9cdfbf12d1ed, inference/transnetv2-weights) within 3e-7 (vision SPEC, 'Shot boundaries'). transnetv2-coreml (IX2-S8, 2026-10-19): upstream TransNetV2 (github.com/soCzech/TransNetV2 commit 85cef72af9a916bdfd7cc94a670c9cdfbf12d1ed, MIT; sha256 of every upstream file used in tools/components/transnetv2-coreml/checksums.txt): the TF SavedModel's weights through upstream's convert_weights.py into upstream's PyTorch port (matching TF on every output), a Core ML rewrite of that port (coreml_model.py: histograms by one-hot and a matmul, the similarity band by pad and reshape, each (2+1)D Conv3d as two Conv2d; within 1e-5 of the port), converted with coremltools 8.3.0 (torch 2.5.1, tensorflow 2.19.1: build tools only, not shipped) to an fp32 ML Program for macOS 14, compiled with xcrun coremlcompiler and packed with the recipe above by tools/components/pack-transnetv2-coreml.sh, after a parity gate against the transnetv2 ONNX on every ix-v1 window. A second pack gives the same bytes. Archive layout: LICENSE (upstream's), TransNetV2.mlmodelc/.

EmbeddingGemma 2 by Google DeepMind, Apache-2.0. ONNX conversion and quantisation (q4 text graph, q4f16 vision graph) by onnx-community (embeddinggemma-2-ONNX); Taalcut ships the text and vision graphs only.

EmbeddingGemma 2 by Google DeepMind, Apache-2.0. Core ML graphs by FluidInference (embeddinggemma-2-coreml, Apache-2.0), compiled for Core ML by Taalcut (tools/components/pack-embeddinggemma-coreml.sh), with the weights of onnx-community's q4 text and q4f16 vision quantisation (embeddinggemma-2-ONNX), which the app writes into them on first use from the installed embeddinggemma-2 component by a recipe (weights.json, tools/components/embeddinggemma-coreml/weight_recipe.py). For the mac helper on macOS 15 and later.
PP-OCRv5 mobile text detection and devanagari_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec by PaddlePaddle (PaddleOCR), Apache-2.0. ONNX exports by PaddlePaddle.

TransNetV2 shot transition detection by Tomáš Souček and Jakub Lokoč, MIT licence (code and weights, Copyright (c) 2020 Tomáš Souček). ONNX export by elya5 (hf.co/elya5/transnetv2, MIT) of a PyTorch port of the upstream weights.

TransNetV2 shot transition detection by Tomáš Souček and Jakub Lokoč, MIT licence (code and weights, Copyright (c) 2020 Tomáš Souček).
